summary: Pilot procurement: Labelbox seats + Okta SCIM onboarding for data labeling evaluation
description: Issue summary: Data Platform requests a 10-seat 6-week pilot of Labelbox (managed SaaS) for a training-data quality evaluation across vision and multimodal projects. Impact: Without temporary access we cannot complete the annotation throughput eval or measure labeling latency/cost tradeoffs for upcoming model retrains. Requested outcome: Procurement of 10 temporary paid seats, Okta SCIM provisioning, SOC2 Type II evidence, and confirmation of data-at-rest encryption policy prior to pilot start. Background: Research & Applied ML needs a vendor to run a side-by-side labeling exercise (Labelbox vs internal tool) to decide whether to adopt for Q3 annotation scale-up. We have an existing 30-day trial but it lacks SCIM/SSO and invoice tagging. Requirements: 1) 10 named seats for 6 weeks (start target 2026-03-15) 2) Okta SCIM provisioning + SSO via SAML with group sync 3) Access to SOC2 report & pen-test summary 4) Support for customer-managed KMS or confirmation of encrypted keys 5) Monthly invoice, PO to be applied to cost center DLP-Analytics-2026-Q1 6) Contact/primary CSM and escalation path. Budget: Estimated $3,600 total for pilot (vendor quote attached). Timeline: Approval by 2026-03-10 to meet vendor start date 2026-03-15. If procurement cannot be completed, request workaround: extend trial for 30 days with manual user invites and temporary project-level encryption controls.
